ETON by Polygon UBC Westbrook Village: Tranquil parkside living adjacent to Pacific Spirit Regional Park, with convenient access to Westbrook shopping amenities.

Introducing an oasis of modern comfort nestled in a serene enclave, this meticulously designed furnished 2-bedroom+den rental residence boasts a tranquil ambiance overlooking a lush private courtyard landscape with a soothing water feature. With a thoughtful layout placing bedrooms on opposite sides for enhanced privacy, the 949-square-foot space exudes sophistication with contemporary finishes and 9-foot ceilings. Premium Bosch appliances adorn the sleek kitchen, featuring a 5-burner cooktop and counter-depth integrated refrigerator. Luxurious touches extend to the primary ensuite, showcasing a European-style thermostatic shower system with marble wall tiles and a ceiling rain shower head. Additional highlights include a private balcony, full AC, premium engineered-wood flooring, roller shades on all windows, and in-suite laundry facilities. Welcome to your sanctuary of urban tranquility.
